query: Get a second opinion on this auth refactor before I merge it. It adds JWT refresh-token rotation.
expected_behavior: Establishes a primary review baseline (from /review-pr or a direct read) before dispatching
Dispatches the diff to a second model via .forge/second_opinion.py with context about what the change does
Reconciles the two reviews into agreements (high-confidence) and disagreements (investigate)
Ranks the surviving findings P0-P3 by user harm and leads with the agreements
